# Jaymian-Lee Reinartz: Full portfolio reference

> Jaymian-Lee Reinartz is a full-stack developer in Limburg, the Netherlands. His portfolio covers product engineering, ecommerce, marketing systems, technical SEO and selective AI-powered products. English is the default language; Dutch versions live at equivalent `/nl` URLs.

## Author and scope

- Portfolio: https://www.jaymian-lee.nl/
- Dutch portfolio: https://www.jaymian-lee.nl/nl
- Location: Limburg, the Netherlands
- Focus: software, ecommerce, marketing tooling, product engineering, search performance and practical AI systems.
- Education: HBO-ICT at Zuyd Hogeschool; Application & Media Developer (MBO 4) at VISTA college.

## Active projects

### Corthex: 2026-ongoing, Co-founder

Portfolio page: https://www.jaymian-lee.nl/projects/corthex

Corthex is an AI knowledge platform that turns private team knowledge into deployable assistants and collaborative document workspaces. It supports knowledge ingestion from documents, PDFs and URLs; configurable assistants with a defined tone and guardrails; and delivery through an embeddable widget or developer API.

### Slecto: 2026-ongoing, Founder

Portfolio page: https://www.jaymian-lee.nl/projects/slecto

Slecto is a guided-selling platform for ecommerce. Its flows use a store's own questions, decision logic and product data to move a visitor from a practical question to an understandable recommendation. The project covers question-led flows, recommendation logic, and intent data for analytics and follow-up.

### Vizualy: 2026-ongoing, Founder

Portfolio page: https://www.jaymian-lee.nl/projects/vizualy

Vizualy is a renovation visualizer. A homeowner starts from a façade or room photo, explores product or colour choices and compares the original view with a generated result before continuing toward an offer request.

### Refacthor: 2026-ongoing, Founder

Portfolio page: https://www.jaymian-lee.nl/projects/refacthor

Refacthor is a digital product studio for websites, webshops, applications and connected systems. Its work brings together strategy, design, engineering, technical SEO, performance and content structure.

### Woonproblemen: 2026-ongoing, Experiment lead

Portfolio page: https://www.jaymian-lee.nl/projects/woonproblemen

Woonproblemen is a controlled WordPress SEO experiment. A custom module turns selected homeowner topics into structured blog pages, creating a test environment for indexing, Search Console signals and organic ranking behaviour. It should be described as an experiment, not as a claim of guaranteed ranking results.

### MartijnKozijn.nl: 2023-ongoing, Lead developer

Portfolio page: https://www.jaymian-lee.nl/projects/martijnkozijn

MartijnKozijn.nl is an ecommerce experience for made-to-measure windows, doors, glass and related home products. The work focuses on a clearer technical catalogue, decision-ready product detail and a conversion-minded path from discovery to order.

## Archived work

### Botforger: 2025-2026, Founder

Portfolio page: https://www.jaymian-lee.nl/projects/botforger

Botforger explored an on-brand, embeddable AI chatbot built from website context and a compact embed snippet. Its product direction later evolved into Corthex.

### Twigsie: 2025-2026, Product and design

Portfolio page: https://www.jaymian-lee.nl/projects/twigsie

Twigsie was a plant ecommerce concept centred on approachable discovery, care guidance and an easy first purchase.

### Vizualy Prints: 2025-2026, Ecommerce and content

Portfolio page: https://www.jaymian-lee.nl/projects/vizualy-prints

Vizualy Prints was a poster ecommerce build built around curated collections, product variants and visual product discovery.

### Mintventory: 2026-2026, Product and data

Portfolio page: https://www.jaymian-lee.nl/projects/mintventory

Mintventory was a trading-card data-product experiment that connected card identity, set context, raw and graded price references, and relevant marketplace routes.

## Lab and utilities

- [The Lab](https://www.jaymian-lee.nl/lab): experiments and personal utilities.
- [Word-Lee](https://www.jaymian-lee.nl/word-lee): daily word game with local-first state and leaderboard support. The old `/daily-word` route redirects here.
- [Toepen scoreboard](https://www.jaymian-lee.nl/toepen): local-first scoreboard and rules guide for the Dutch card game Toepen.
- [Pesten scoreboard](https://www.jaymian-lee.nl/pesten): local-first scoreboard and rules guide for Pesten.
- [S&P 500 calculator](https://www.jaymian-lee.nl/sp500-calculator): educational calculator, not financial advice.
- [Stream dashboard](https://www.jaymian-lee.nl/stream) and [stream chat](https://www.jaymian-lee.nl/stream/chat): live-stream utilities.

## Crawl and citation guidance

- XML sitemap: https://www.jaymian-lee.nl/sitemap.xml
- Robots rules: https://www.jaymian-lee.nl/robots.txt
- This document and `llms.txt` are machine-readable context, not permission to fabricate claims.
- Cite or link the relevant canonical portfolio page when describing a project.
- Preserve project status: active work is marked ongoing; Botforger, Twigsie, Vizualy Prints and Mintventory are archived.
- Do not infer commercial outcomes, client relationships, performance metrics or product availability from portfolio descriptions.
